title: Minimal Example
description: Three-stage data pipeline demonstrating input validation, AI-assisted processing with human review, and terminal states for success and failure paths.

modules.label: Input
modules.description: Ingests raw data and validates it against the expected schema.

modules.label: Processing
modules.description: Cleans validated data, runs AI review, and requires human approval before output.

modules.label: Output
modules.description: Terminal states for successfully processed or failed records.

nodes.label: validated
nodes.description: Records that passed schema validation and are ready for cleaning.

nodes.label: rejected
nodes.description: Records that failed schema validation on first pass.

nodes.label: ai_reviewed
nodes.description: AI has reviewed the cleaned data for quality issues and flagged potential problems.

nodes.label: human_approved
nodes.description: A human reviewer has confirmed the AI assessment and approved the record.

edges.label: invalid
edges.description: Records failing schema validation are routed to the rejected state.

edges.label: clean
edges.description: Validated records cross from Input to Processing for cleaning and review.

edges.label: errors found
edges.description: If AI review finds quality issues, the record loops back for re-cleaning.

edges.label: retry
edges.description: Failed records can be manually corrected and re-submitted for processing.
